mapper.select: SELECT kind, id FROM ( SELECT 'GENERATION' kind, id, created_at FROM afv_remote_generation_job WHERE state IN ('NEEDS_REVIEW','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION') UNION ALL SELECT 'TEXT' kind, id, created_at FROM afv_canvas_text_job WHERE status IN ('NEEDS_REVIEW','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION') UNION ALL SELECT 'MCP' kind, id, created_at FROM afv_canvas_mcp_job WHERE status IN ('NEEDS_REVIEW','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION') UNION ALL SELECT 'AGENT_MODEL' kind, id, created_at FROM afv_agent_model_request WHERE status = 'UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION' UNION ALL SELECT 'CANVAS_MEDIA' kind, j.id, j.created_at FROM afv_media_job j JOIN afv_canvas_media_job m ON m.job_id = j.id WHERE j.status IN ('NEEDS_REVIEW','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION') UNION ALL SELECT 'COMFY_TEST' kind, j.id, j.created_at FROM afv_media_job j JOIN afv_comfyui_test_run m ON m.job_id = j.id WHERE j.status IN ('NEEDS_REVIEW','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION') UNION ALL SELECT 'EPISODE_AUDIO' kind, j.id, j.created_at FROM afv_media_job j JOIN afv_episode_audio_job m ON m.job_id = j.id WHERE j.status IN ('NEEDS_REVIEW','UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION') ) pending ORDER BY created_at, kind, id LIMIT 51 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id,m.status,m.revision,r.user_id actor_user_id,r.actor_team_id,r.project_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.canvas_scope_json,'$.canvasId')) canvas_id,NULL run_id,m.permit_held, r.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL cancelled,TRUE started,m.response_received_at IS NOT NULL received FROM afv_agent_model_request m JOIN afv_agent_run r ON r.run_id=m.run_id WHERE m.id = #{id}
